primer: Cheniere Energy operates a premier 56 mtpa U.S. LNG export platform anchored by $112.2 billion of contracted backlog and timely Corpus Christi Stage 3 completion. However, 2026 earnings leaned on temporary Strait of Hormuz shipping spikes while gross consolidated debt expanded to $24.138 billion ahead of $1.2 billion in new 5.800% parent notes. At $294.84, normalized 2027 net parent FCF yields just 5.31% versus 5.04% 10-year Treasuries, giving only 1.35:1 support asymmetry to our $315.00 Base fair value above our ratcheted $281.56 stop. We assign REJECTED (TIER_0) to new capital while retaining all 6.2472 Schwab shares under HOLD_WITH_HARD_STOP at $281.56.
